card_budget_positions_amounts.name: card_budget_positions_amounts
card_budget_positions_amounts.value: ("card_budget_positions"."requested_amount" is null or "card_budget_positions"."requested_amount" between 0 and 2000000000) and ("card_budget_positions"."approved_amount" is null or "card_budget_positions"."approved_amount" between 0 and 2000000000) and ("card_budget_positions"."actual_amount" is null or "card_budget_positions"."actual_amount" between 0 and 2000000000)

email_confirmation_subject_check.name: email_confirmation_subject_check
email_confirmation_subject_check.value: ("email_confirmation_settings"."kind" in ('application','feedback') and "email_confirmation_settings"."board_id" is not null and "email_confirmation_settings"."inventory_board_id" is null) or ("email_confirmation_settings"."kind" = 'inventory' and "email_confirmation_settings"."inventory_board_id" is not null and "email_confirmation_settings"."board_id" is null)
